response.title: Christ Church, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania Genealogy
response.content:
## Christ Church, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania Genealogy

Christ Church (Anglican/Episcopal) is the oldest Christian congregation in Pennsylvania, founded in 1695.

### Original Registers

The original baptism, marriage, and burial registers are held by the **Christ Church Preservation Trust**, 20 N. American Street, Philadelphia, PA 19106 (phone: 215-922-1695). Researchers must contact the Preservation Trust directly to arrange access to the originals.

### Microfilmed Copies

Microfilm copies are available at the Family History Library and through FamilySearch:
- Baptisms and burials, 1709-1800 (volumes 1-28): FamilySearch film 1490578, DGS 7615596
- Marriages and burials, 1801-1900 (volumes 43-72): FamilySearch film 1490580, DGS 7615594

### Published Transcription

A transcription of the early registers was published as *Baptisms and Burials from the Register of Christ Church, Philadelphia, 1709-1800* by Charles R. Barker. Printed copies can be found at the **Historical Society of Pennsylvania (HSP)**, 1300 Locust Street, Philadelphia, PA 19107. HSP holds the published volume, not the original registers.

### Online Access

Browsable images of the microfilmed registers are available on FamilySearch.org (free, with account).

### Research Tips

- For marriages before 1730, couples announced banns rather than obtaining a license.
- St. Peters Church (founded 1761) shared a combined register with Christ Church from approximately 1761 to 1810.
